# Lightbox

Preview one image or navigate a gallery in a modal dialog.

<ComponentPreview align="start" justify="start" height="40rem">

```html
<style>
  .preview-gallery {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: var(--size-3);
  }
  .preview-gallery > button {
    display: block;
    padding: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    cursor: zoom-in;
    background: var(--color-contrast-100);
    border: var(--border) solid var(--color-divider);
    border-radius: var(--rounded-lg);
    transition: border-color var(--transition-fast), box-shadow var(--transition-fast);
  }
  .preview-gallery > button:hover {
    border-color: var(--color-primary-focus);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  }
  .preview-gallery > button:focus-visible {
    outline: var(--border-2) solid var(--color-primary-focus);
    outline-offset: var(--size-0-5);
  }
  .preview-gallery img {
    display: block;
    object-fit: cover;
  }
  .preview-gallery img[hidden] {
    display: none;
  }
</style>
<ore-lightbox class="preview-gallery" label="Application previews">
  <button type="button" aria-label="Preview CRM home">
    <ore-skeleton width="var(--size-32)" height="var(--size-20)" aria-hidden="true"></ore-skeleton>
    <img hidden width="128" height="80" alt="CRM home" src="data:image/webp;base64,">
  </button>
  <button type="button" aria-label="Preview CRM pipeline">
    <ore-skeleton width="var(--size-32)" height="var(--size-20)" aria-hidden="true"></ore-skeleton>
    <img hidden width="128" height="80" alt="CRM pipeline" src="data:image/webp;base64,">
  </button>
</ore-lightbox>
<script>
  document.querySelectorAll('ore-lightbox > button').forEach((button) => {
    const image = button.querySelector('img');
    const skeleton = button.querySelector('ore-skeleton');
    const reveal = () => {
      skeleton.remove();
      image.hidden = false;
    };
    if (image.complete) reveal();
    else {
      image.addEventListener('load', reveal, { once: true });
      image.addEventListener('error', reveal, { once: true });
    }
  });
</script>
```

</ComponentPreview>

The example shows skeletons until the thumbnails load. Embedded images keep it runnable in the preview sandbox.

Each direct child button containing an image is a trigger. The image's `alt` describes the preview. Set `data-preview-src` on the button for a separate full-size image; otherwise its image source is used. Items stay in DOM order and can be added, removed, or updated while open.

The close button or Escape closes the preview. Previous and next buttons and the left and right arrow keys navigate without wrapping. Select a thumbnail between the arrows to jump directly to an image. The thumbnail window follows the current image; use the arrows to reach images outside it. On narrow screens the window can also scroll horizontally. Focus returns to the invoking button when possible. A skeleton appears while the image loads; a failure message appears if it cannot load.

## Properties

| Property | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `Image preview` | Dialog name |
| `close-label` | `Close preview` | Close button name |
| `previous-label` | `Previous image` | Previous button name |
| `next-label` | `Next image` | Next button name |
| `loading-label` | `Loading image` | Loading message |
| `max-thumbnails` | `5` | Maximum thumbnail buttons in the moving window; a positive safe integer. Invalid values use the default and warn in development |
| `error-label` | `Image could not be loaded.` | Failure message |
| `position-label` | `{current} of {total}` | Position message; retain both placeholders when translating |

## Events and styling

`open-change` emits `{ open, reason }`. `change` emits `{ index, count, src, alt }` when the current image changes; `index` is zero-based.

Use `--lightbox-bg` and `--lightbox-backdrop` to customize the modal. The `dialog`, `image`, `close`, `previous`, `next`, `thumbnails`, `thumbnail`, and `status` parts expose its elements.
